mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We currently have clear skies and a comfortable 68 degrees over Verona Area High School. It is a peaceful night with a visible waxing crescent moon, though we will not have any visible passes of the International Space Station tonight.

In city news, Verona is reminding apartment residents about sustainable composting options, such as using private services or the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop. The city also shared updates on its ongoing eco-friendly transit initiatives, including anti-idling technology on new ambulances and maintaining its status as a Bronze Level Bicycle Friendly Community.

Looking at our upcoming schedule, we have some fantastic weekend events including live music at Bailey's Run and the Mount Horeb Art Fair on July 19th. Later in the week, look forward to Verona's premier local gathering, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, at Hometown Junction Park on Wednesday, July 22nd.

In police news, last Thursday morning, July 9th, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash with injuries at County Highway PB and American Way, where a teenage driver was cited for failing to yield the right-of-way to an older driver who sustained minor injuries.

Today's mouth-watering Culver's flavor of the day is Turtle. While the restaurant is currently closed, they will open their doors at 10 AM today to serve this delicious classic. Tomorrow's flavor is currently unknown.
